meta.note: cap weights = free-float market cap in Rs crore on one scale (terminal mcap_cr = AMFI 6-month-average full mcap, x list ff_factor, one scale for every member), held constant through time; equal-weight series has no such assumption. Freshness wall: a member's score counts for a month only if its last genuine change is within 92 days of that month-end (revisions.FRESH_DAYS).
meta.weight_basis: mcap_cr (vistas.shares.mcap_resolved) x ff_factor (constituent list), Rs crore
